description: Recovers guarded past-tense correction for fronted explicit-past-marker plus subject plus whitelisted present/base verb shapes.
fp_risk_note: Medium risk. Explicit past markers can still appear in habitual, narrative, or multi-clause contexts. V1 only corrects single-clause, unambiguous explicit-past-marker plus present/base verb shapes and excludes weekday/habitual cases.
